summary.intent: Complete Phase 20 vault migration gap closure (remove dead migration code), merge the PR, and fix a critical architectural bug where the vault key blob IPNS was being overwritten by standard v1 folder metadata publishes.
summary.outcome: Phase 20 executed and verified (9/9 truths, 143 regression tests), PR #344 merged. Identified and fixed vault IPNS architecture bug by separating vault key blob into its own HKDF-derived IPNS name, then further simplified the v2 blob format to key-only (removing embedded metadata copy). New PR #349 opened on fix/vault-key-ipns-separation.

repo: Vault IPNS topology now uses two separate names: cipherbox-vault-key-ipns-v1 (key blob, written once at init) and cipherbox-vault-ipns-v1 (root folder metadata, updated on every mutation). Previously the root folder IPNS was overwritten by v1 JSON on any folder operation, breaking next login.

TypeORM auto-discovers migrations from the migrations/ directory glob — no explicit imports needed. FullSchema migration was consolidated by removing two add-then-drop migrations (AddVaultMigratedAt, DropVaultCryptoColumns) before DB reset.
The v2 blob format was simplified to key-only: 0x02 | uint16_BE(key_len) | ECIES_key. The metadata portion was dead weight after init since login only extracts encryptedRootFolderKey.
orval API client regeneration does not clean up stale model files — orphaned .ts files must be deleted manually after removing DTO fields.
Desktop vault.rs was registering the vault on the backend BEFORE publishing to IPFS/IPNS. The correct order (matching web) is: IPFS upload → IPNS publish → API registration.

CodeRabbit and Copilot repeatedly flagged v1 folder metadata publishes as inconsistent with v2 blob reads because the v1/v2 split was not documented. Root vault blob and folder metadata are fundamentally different formats.

code.finding: Simplified serialize to take only encryptedRootFolderKey (no metadata param); deserialize returns Uint8Array directly instead of VaultBlobV2 object. Zero-length key validation added to both directions.
Added deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair with info string cipherbox-vault-key-ipns-v1, separate from existing cipherbox-vault-ipns-v1 for root folder IPNS.
Critical bug: vault was registered on backend before IPFS upload + IPNS publish. Fixed to match web client order: IPFS-first, then API registration.
Removed encrypt_root_metadata_to_v2_blob function — root folder now uses encrypt_metadata_to_json like all other folders, since rootFolderKey lives in the dedicated vault key IPNS.
Removed v2 blob detection from fetchAndDecryptMetadata — all folder IPNS records are now v1 JSON.
Login reads rootFolderKey from vault key IPNS (new derivation); new user init publishes key blob to vault key IPNS and v1 metadata to root folder IPNS separately.
Consolidated to reflect post-Phase-20 schema: vaults table has only ownerPublicKey and rootIpnsName, no crypto columns.

Added fetchWithTimeout with AbortController; .finally(clearTimeout) pattern was wrong — removed so abort timer covers body reads. Added rootIpnsName format validation and HTML escaping. HKDF info updated to vault key IPNS derivation.

workflow: GitHub outside-diff review comments do not create resolvable threads — they only appear in the review body. Must fetch the full review body separately and reply/fix manually.
When a planner subagent commits its own files, the orchestrator should not attempt a duplicate commit — check recent git log before committing planning artifacts.

AbortController timeout cleanup via .finally() is incorrect when you need the timeout to also cover response body reads (.json()/.arrayBuffer()). The controller should stay active through the full read.
After merging a branch, any file writes during cleanup (like todo captures) will be on the old branch. Switch to main/new branch before writing.

friction: 5 rounds of PR review comment resolution required — CodeRabbit and Copilot repeatedly misunderstood v1 vs v2 blob scope, flagging correct code as inconsistent.
GitHub outside-diff critical comment (vault.rs init ordering) was not surfaced as a thread — only discovered by fetching the full review body with a separate GraphQL query.
Todo was written to disk on the already-merged phase-20 branch; had to recreate it on a fresh branch after switching to main.
orval API client regeneration left orphaned model files (vaultResponseDtoEncryptedRoot*.ts) that had to be manually deleted — caused a build failure mid-session.
Windows cargo check is the last CI gate, creating a wait period after all other checks pass before auto-merge completes.

SDK E2E tests were still sending deprecated crypto fields (encryptedRootFolderKey, encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey) in vault init requests — API rejected them with whitelist validation error, surfaced only after CI run.
open_items: Two items require human verification in a live environment: new user init publishing v2 blob to IPFS before API registration, and recovery tool IPFS-direct path with real vault.
PR #349 (fix/vault-key-ipns-separation with key-only v2 blob format) not yet reviewed or merged — awaiting CodeRabbit/Copilot review pass.
METADATA_SCHEMAS.md v1.1 update was committed to fix/vault-key-ipns-separation branch, not yet on main.
Cross-platform test vectors for the simplified key-only v2 blob format need to be verified against the Rust implementation in CI.
